title: "The file steps"
description: "The steps that read, write, list and move files, build CSV or Excel, and read a PDF, all fenced to one directory and off until you set it."
editUrl: false
---

The file steps (read, write, list, move, delete, build a CSV or Excel file,
read Excel or a PDF's text, and the trigger for a file that shows up) work in
one directory, `HOTLOOP_CASCADE_FILES_DIR`, and can't reach anything outside
it. With none set they are off.
